meta.note: "near" holds the closest receiving water per map layer, keyed as the map keys its layers, so the answer can follow what is switched on. "dist" is the overall nearest and does not move when a layer is toggled, because the risk score is scaled from it. Risk is the category load weight scaled by closeness to water: a screening aid for prioritising inspection, not a measured discharge — none of these sources is metered.
